title: QUESTION data storage & GDPR
body:
Hi,

Given the recent changes in laws regarding privacy and the obligation of being conform to the GDPR rules/regulations, I was wondering if InstaPy stores any data of the users' profiles it interacts with. I suppose some data is temporarily stored but I was wondering if any data is saved permanently.

Does anyone have an idea?

Thanks!
